title: The Fate of Black Hole-Induced Moduli Excursions in the Presence of Scalar Potentials
summary: Large charged black holes can create macroscopic, locally weakly curved regions in which moduli take values different from their asymptotic values. We study how robust this mechanism is once the scalar has a nontrivial potential. In four-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory, the massless GHS solution provides a finite exterior throat in which the scalar and the gauge coupling vary logarithmically.
